title: VTC→Chat guide: live captions via ephemeral events
description: Section on delivering live captions through Chat WSS. Caption as a custom ephemeral event on the bound chatId WebSocket. Fields: senderId (speaker attribution), text (caption text), language, isFinal (partial vs final). ChatStreamEnable with dataTypes including vtc. Client rendering: subtitle overlay on video. Speaker identification. JSON example of caption event delivery.
